The diary of Henry Boswell Jones of Brownsburg

Henry Boswell Jones

Jones was a prominent farmer in Brownsburg, Virginia with an active public life. In his diary (1841-1872), he documented his daily life and social events, as well as meteorological conditions, agricultural practices, and information about enslaved people.
